description: This file defines the 'ConcurrentLoadGenerator' class, a generic utility for performing concurrent load testing by issuing requests across multiple worker tasks and collecting statistics on request successes, failures, and throughput.

classes.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1
classes.description: A generic concurrent load generator for stress testing APIs or services, configurable with worker count, request batch sizes, and request logic.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the load generator with parameters such as maximum concurrency, blocks per worker, requests per block, and request handling functions.

methods.name: Warmup
methods.description: Performs a warmup run to initialize resources and prepare the generator without recording results.

methods.name: ResetBetweenRuns
methods.description: Resets the internal state and channel between different run sessions.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the actual load test, manages worker tasks, collects blocks, and reports intermediate and total results.

methods.name: PrintReport
methods.description: Generates a textual report summarizing the number of requests per second, total requests, and failures.

methods.name: RunWorker
methods.description: Performs requests in a loop for a specified number of blocks, updating success/failure counts, and timestamps.
